## Summary

Explain the problem and the change, including any user-visible behavior.

## Related issues

Link related issues, or write N/A.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. State anything not tested.
For UI changes, include keyboard/responsive checks and synthetic-data screenshots
where useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and reviewed the full change.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Fixtures, logs and screenshots contain no real personal data or credentials.
- [ ] UI changes follow ACCESSIBILITY.md, or this PR does not change the UI.
- [ ] I reviewed and can explain all contributions, including AI-assisted work.
